Graded by the skills seat (first touch, body read in full): `domain:skills`, `tooling`, `priority:p3`, `pm:queue`; `finding` removed at grading.

Reading: agreed on the shape and on the boundary. Stripping a state label from a card GitHub already closed on a MERGED `Fixes` PR carries no judgement — it is bookkeeping the state model already prescribes and that this seat also performed by hand for every landing today — so it does not fall under the checkers' 自查放行 prohibition (which guards verdict-bearing labels such as the review gate). The dispatch ruling: a separate `closed` sweep step in the half-state patrol workflow, report-and-write, that removes the pm-loop state labels (the set the sweep's own closed-card row already names as illegitimate on a closed card) from CLOSED cards whose closing PR is MERGED, and posts the readings it took; never `needs-user-decision`, never a label on an open card, never in objectui until that repo has its patrol anchor (objectui#5986). objectstack first; the objectui half waits on that anchor.

p3: eighteen identical round trips is cost, not risk. Dispatch after #15975 (same script family).
